C1_1_S1_rationale_correction.target: configs/final_analysis_plan_v2_2.json .S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.why_it_is_robustness_and_not_confound_correction, and the corresponding section of the A2 narrative
C1_1_S1_rationale_correction.action: the claims quoted below are WITHDRAWN as over-stated and replaced by the corrected statement. A2 itself is not edited; this record supersedes those specific clauses.
withdrawn_claims: any family-affinity term is constant within a (task, scorer) cell across conditions and cancels exactly in the paired within-cell difference no_history - self_low_2
It cannot manufacture or reverse a condition contrast
A level shift matters only through a range/ceiling mechanism
Compression works against the hypothesis, so the direction is conservative
compression rather than inflation of the measured effect is the expected consequence
C1_1_S1_rationale_correction.why_withdrawn: the cancellation argument is valid only for an ADDITIVE affinity term. It was stated unconditionally, which implicitly assumed away interaction effects. The ceiling-compression claim additionally asserted a direction of bias that is not established.

corrected_statement.what_does_cancel: Because the candidate answer for a given task is byte-identical across all six conditions, an ADDITIVE answer-family affinity -- one that shifts a (task, scorer) cell's score LEVEL uniformly across conditions -- cancels in the paired within-cell contrast.
corrected_statement.what_does_not_cancel: That covers the additive case only. A scorer-family-by-condition INTERACTION, in which the scorer's responsiveness to the injected history differs for same-family content, would NOT cancel and could moderate the treatment effect.
corrected_statement.direction_of_any_interaction: not established. No claim is made that such an interaction must attenuate rather than amplify the effect.
corrected_statement.ceiling_and_floor_compression: one candidate mechanism for such an interaction, but neither its occurrence nor its direction is established here, and it must not be presented as a reason the estimate is conservative.
corrected_statement.purpose_of_S1_restated: S1 tests whether the primary conclusion depends materially on including the OLMo scorer.
what_S1_does_not_establish: that any scorer-family-by-condition interaction is absent
a direction or magnitude of bias in the four-scorer primary

anonymity_and_identical_answer_facts_ret.note: both facts remain true and remain worth stating; they are what makes the additive component cancel. They do not by themselves rule out an interaction.

C1_1_S1_rationale_correction.reporting_requirement: the write-up must state the additive/interaction distinction explicitly rather than asserting exact cancellation, and must not describe the primary estimate as conservative on the basis of a compression argument.

C1_2_use_cache_requirement.action: tightened from 'assert the effective use_cache is True' to the explicit two-part setting plus a mandatory equivalence comparison.
implementation_requirements: explicitly set model.config.use_cache = True after loading the OLMo scorer
explicitly pass use_cache=True to every generate() call for the OLMo scorer
do not rely on GenerationConfig defaults or on inheritance from config.json, which ships use_cache=false

prerun_equivalence_check.when: before the final run, as part of preflight
prerun_equivalence_check.set: the canonical preflight task wildbench/00c7916a072b4947 with the standard placeholder candidate answer, rendered under all six frozen conditions
prerun_equivalence_check.n_calls_note: 6 units x 2 cache settings (cache-on and cache-off)
prerun_equivalence_check.consumes_study_data_note: the placeholder answer is not a frozen candidate answer, so this check touches no study observation
prerun_equivalence_check.decoding: deterministic: do_sample=False, transformers.set_seed(42), max_new_tokens=512, identical prompt and identical decoding config in both arms
prerun_equivalence_check.criterion: EXACT equality of generated token IDs between the cache-on and cache-off arms for all six conditions
prerun_equivalence_check.on_any_discrepancy: STOP and investigate; return for review. Do not silently proceed, do not prefer the faster arm, and do not treat a mismatch as acceptable numerical noise.
prerun_equivalence_check.rationale: under greedy decoding the output must be invariant to KV caching. A discrepancy indicates a numerical or implementation fault that would also threaten run-to-run reproducibility, so it must be understood before hours of compute are committed.
prerun_equivalence_check.scope: required for the OLMo scorer, which ships use_cache=false. Recommended but not required for the other three scorers, which do not.

C1_2_use_cache_requirement.classification: cost and correctness-verification requirement. Caching cannot change which tokens greedy decoding selects; the check exists to confirm that, not to choose between two acceptable outputs.

any_larger_batch_requires_both: exact token-ID equivalence against the batch-1 path on the frozen 288-call smoke set
a measured memory preflight showing the intended batch size fits the measured headroom

C1_3_olmo_batching_reaffirmed.on_mismatch_or_oom: permanent fallback to batch size 1 for this model only; never inferred across models
